Insight Categorical Features vs Diagnosed Diabetes¶

  • Sex Male patients face substantially higher heart disease risk and should be prioritized for early screening.

  • Chest Pain Type Asymptomatic patients (Type 4) show the highest disease rate (~70%), making this one of the strongest predictors.

  • Fasting Blood Sugar (>120 mg/dL) Elevated fasting blood sugar is significantly associated with heart disease, reflecting diabetes-related risk.

  • EKG Results Abnormal ECG readings (Type 2) have the highest prevalence (~56%), indicating important cardiac abnormalities.

  • Exercise-Induced Angina Patients experiencing chest pain during exercise show extremely high disease risk (~81%), making this a powerful clinical indicator.

  • Slope of ST Segment Flat and down-sloping patterns (Types 2 and 3) are linked to much higher disease rates (~69%–72%).

  • Number of Vessels (Fluoroscopy) Patients with 2–3 affected vessels have very high disease prevalence (~90%), representing one of the strongest diagnostic signals.

  • Thallium Test Abnormal perfusion patterns (Type 7) show the highest risk (~82%), making this a key diagnostic feature.

📊 Overall Picture¶

Feature Summary
sex Male patients show substantially higher disease prevalence, making gender an important demographic risk factor.
chest_pain_type One of the strongest predictors — asymptomatic type (Type 4) has the highest risk (~70%), strongly indicating underlying heart disease.
fbs_over_120 Elevated fasting blood sugar is significantly associated with heart disease, reflecting diabetes-related cardiovascular risk.
ekg_results Abnormal ECG patterns (Type 2) show markedly higher prevalence (~56%), confirming ECG as a key diagnostic indicator.
exercise_angina Very strong predictor — exercise-induced chest pain is linked to extremely high disease risk (~81%).
slope_of_st Flat and down-sloping ST segments (Types 2–3) show substantially elevated risk (~69%–72%), indicating ischemic abnormalities.
number_of_vessels_fluro One of the strongest imaging-based predictors — patients with 2–3 affected vessels show very high prevalence (~90%).
thallium Highly powerful diagnostic feature — abnormal perfusion (Type 7) shows the highest risk (~82%).
age Heart disease patients are generally older, confirming age as a major non-modifiable risk factor.
bp No meaningful difference between groups → blood pressure alone has limited standalone predictive value.
cholesterol Statistically significant but small practical effect, serving mainly as a supporting risk marker.
max_hr Diseased patients have significantly lower exercise heart rates, reflecting reduced cardiac capacity and strong predictive power.
st_depression Strong clinical indicator — higher ST depression reflects myocardial ischemia and is strongly linked to heart disease.

    df["chest_pain_vessels"] = df["chest_pain_type"] * df["number_of_vessels_fluro"]
    df["hr_age_ratio"] = df["max_hr"] / (df["age"] + 1)

class TargetEncoder(BaseEstimator, TransformerMixin):
    """
    Target Encoding transformer with optional K-Fold smoothing.

    This encoder replaces categorical values with aggregated statistics
    (e.g., mean target value) computed from the training data. It supports
    cross-validation encoding to prevent target leakage.

    Features:
    - Supports multiple aggregation functions (mean, median, etc.)
    - K-Fold out-of-fold encoding
    - Automatic or manual smoothing
    - Optional removal of original categorical columns
    - Compatible with scikit-learn pipelines
    """

    def __init__(self, cols_to_encode, aggs=["mean"], cv=config.n_split_kfold, smooth="auto",
                 drop_original=False, logger=logger):
        """
        Initialize TargetEncoder.

        Parameters
        ----------
        cols_to_encode : list
            List of categorical columns to encode.

        aggs : list, default=["mean"]
            Aggregation functions applied to target variable.

        cv : int, default=config.n_split_kfold
            Number of folds for out-of-fold encoding.

        smooth : str or float, default="auto"
            Smoothing factor ("auto" or numeric value).

        drop_original : bool, default=False
            Whether to drop original categorical columns.

        logger : logging.Logger
            Logger instance for monitoring encoder behavior.
        """

        self.cols_to_encode = cols_to_encode
        self.aggs = aggs
        self.cv = cv
        self.smooth = smooth
        self.drop_original = drop_original
        self.logger = logger

        # Store mappings and global statistics
        self.mappings_ = {}
        self.global_stats_ = {}

    # Fit encoder using full training data
    def fit(self, X, y):
        """
        Learn target statistics from full dataset.

        Parameters
        ----------
        X : pandas.DataFrame
            Feature matrix.

        y : pandas.Series
            Target variable.

        Returns
        -------
        self
        """

        # self.logger.info("Fitting TargetEncoder...")

        temp_df = X.copy()
        temp_df["target"] = y

        # Compute global target statistics
        for agg_func in self.aggs:
            self.global_stats_[agg_func] = y.agg(agg_func)

        # Compute category-level mappings
        for col in self.cols_to_encode:
            self.mappings_[col] = {}
            for agg_func in self.aggs:
                mapping = temp_df.groupby(col)["target"].agg(agg_func)
                self.mappings_[col][agg_func] = mapping

        # self.logger.info("TargetEncoder fitted successfully.")
        return self

    # Transform new data using learned mappings
    def transform(self, X):
        """
        Apply learned target encoding to new data.

        Parameters
        ----------
        X : pandas.DataFrame
            Input features.

        Returns
        -------
        pandas.DataFrame
            Transformed dataset with encoded features.
        """

        # self.logger.debug("Applying TargetEncoder transform...")
        X_transformed = X.copy()

        # Encode each categorical feature
        for col in self.cols_to_encode:
            for agg_func in self.aggs:
                new_col_name = f"TE_{col}_{agg_func}"
                map_series = self.mappings_[col][agg_func]

                # Map categories to statistics
                X_transformed[new_col_name] = X[col].map(map_series)

                # Fill unseen categories with global statistic
                X_transformed[new_col_name].fillna(self.global_stats_[agg_func], inplace=True)

        # Optionally drop original categorical columns
        if self.drop_original:
            X_transformed.drop(columns=self.cols_to_encode, inplace=True)
            
        return X_transformed

    # Fit-transform with K-Fold leakage prevention
    def fit_transform(self, X, y):
        """
        Perform out-of-fold target encoding using Stratified K-Fold.
        This method prevents target leakage by computing encodings
        only on training folds and applying them to validation folds.
        """

        # self.logger.info("Performing K-Fold target encoding...")

        # Fit global mappings
        self.fit(X, y)
        encoded_features = pd.DataFrame(index=X.index)

        # Stratified K-Fold for classification tasks
        kf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=self.cv, shuffle=True, random_state=config.random_state)

        # Generate out-of-fold encodings
        for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(kf.split(X, y), start=1):

            # self.logger.debug(f"Processing fold {fold}/{self.cv}")
            X_train, y_train = X.iloc[train_idx], y.iloc[train_idx]
            X_val = X.iloc[val_idx]
            
            temp_df_train = X_train.copy()
            temp_df_train["target"] = y_train

            for col in self.cols_to_encode:
                for agg_func in self.aggs:
                    new_col_name = f"TE_{col}_{agg_func}"
                    fold_global_stat = y_train.agg(agg_func)
                    mapping = temp_df_train.groupby(col)["target"].agg(agg_func)

                    # Apply smoothing for mean encoding
                    if agg_func == "mean":
                        counts = temp_df_train.groupby(col)["target"].count()

                        # Auto smoothing factor
                        m = self.smooth
                        if self.smooth == "auto":
                            variance_between = mapping.var()
                            avg_variance_within = temp_df_train.groupby(col)["target"].var().mean()
                            if variance_between > 0:
                                m = avg_variance_within / variance_between
                            else:
                                m = 0

                        # Smoothed mean encoding
                        smoothed_mapping = (counts * mapping + m * fold_global_stat) / (counts + m)
                        encoded_values = X_val[col].map(smoothed_mapping)
                    else:
                        encoded_values = X_val[col].map(mapping)

                    # Handle unseen categories
                    encoded_features.loc[X_val.index, new_col_name] = encoded_values.fillna(fold_global_stat)

        # Merge encoded features into final dataset
        X_transformed = X.copy()
        for col in encoded_features.columns:
            X_transformed[col] = encoded_features[col]

        # Optionally remove original categorical columns
        if self.drop_original:
            X_transformed.drop(columns=self.cols_to_encode, inplace=True)

        # self.logger.info("Target encoding completed.")

        return X_transformed

def plot_oof_metrics(y_true, oof_preds, fold_preds, threshold=0.5):
    """
    Plot ROC, Precision-Recall curves (by fold) and Confusion Matrix (OOF)

    Parameters
    ----------
    y_true : array-like
        Ground truth labels

    oof_preds : array-like
        Out-of-fold predicted probabilities

    fold_preds : list of tuples
        Each element: (y_val, val_pred) for each fold

    threshold : float, default=0.5
        Threshold for confusion matrix
    """

    roc_curves = []
    pr_curves = []
    auc_values = []
    ap_values = []

    # ================= Collect metrics per fold =================
    for i, (y_val, val_pred) in enumerate(fold_preds):
        # ROC
        fpr, tpr, _ = roc_curve(y_val, val_pred)
        roc_curves.append((fpr, tpr))

        auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
        auc_values.append(auc)

        # PR
        precision, recall, _ = precision_recall_curve(y_val, val_pred)
        pr_curves.append((recall, precision))

        ap = average_precision_score(y_val, val_pred)
        ap_values.append(ap)

    # ================= Plot =================
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 14))

    # ---------------- ROC ----------------
    ax = axes[0, 0]

    for i, (fpr, tpr) in enumerate(roc_curves):
        ax.plot(fpr, tpr, label=f"Fold {i+1} AUC = {auc_values[i]:.4f}")

    ax.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], "--", color="gray")
    ax.set_title("ROC Curve (Each Fold)", weight="bold")
    ax.set_xlabel("False Positive Rate")
    ax.set_ylabel("True Positive Rate")
    ax.legend()
    ax.grid(True)

    # ---------------- PR ----------------
    ax = axes[0, 1]

    for i, (recall, precision) in enumerate(pr_curves):
        ax.plot(recall, precision, label=f"Fold {i+1} AP = {ap_values[i]:.4f}")

    ax.set_title("Precision–Recall Curve (Each Fold)", weight="bold", pad=15, fontsize=12)
    ax.set_xlabel("Recall")
    ax.set_ylabel("Precision")
    ax.legend()
    ax.grid(True)

    # ---------------- Confusion Matrix ----------------
    ax = axes[1, 0]

    y_pred_label = (oof_preds >= threshold).astype(int)
    cm = confusion_matrix(y_true, y_pred_label)

    sns.heatmap(cm, annot=True, fmt="d", cmap="Blues", ax=ax)
    ax.set_title(f"Confusion Matrix (Threshold = {threshold})", weight="bold", pad=15, fontsize=12)
    ax.set_xlabel("Predicted")
    ax.set_ylabel("True")

    # Empty plot
    axes[1, 1].axis("off")

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

                 "exercise_angina", "st_depression", "slope_of_st", "number_of_vessels_fluro", "thallium"]

# Out-of-Fold predictions for training set (used for global validation)
xgb_oof_preds = np.zeros(len(X))
# Averaged predictions for test set (from all folds)
xgb_test_preds = np.zeros(len(df_test))

# Store predictions of each fold for later visualization/analysis
# Each element: (true_labels, predicted_probs)
fold_preds = []

# Stratified K-Fold to preserve label distribution
kf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=config.n_split_kfold, shuffle=True, random_state=config.random_state)

# Select features for Target Encoding
# Only apply to columns with more than 2 unique values
TE_COLS = [col for col in NUMS_ORIGINAL if df_train[col].nunique() > 2]

logger.info(f"Target Encoding: {len(TE_COLS)} features")
logger.info("="*80)
logger.info("XGBOOST TRAINING START")
logger.info("="*80)

# Cross-validation training loop
for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(kf.split(X, y), 1):

    # Split training and validation data
    X_train, y_train = X.iloc[train_idx].copy(), y.iloc[train_idx]
    X_val, y_val = X.iloc[val_idx].copy(), y.iloc[val_idx]

    # Prepare test set for this fold
    X_test_fold = df_test[FEATURES].copy()

    # Apply Target Encoding (if applicable)
    if len(TE_COLS) > 0:
        TE = TargetEncoder(cols_to_encode=TE_COLS, cv=config.n_split_kfold, smooth="auto", 
                           aggs=["mean", "count"], drop_original=False)

        # Fit only on training data (avoid leakage)
        X_train = TE.fit_transform(X_train, y_train)

        # Transform validation and test
        X_val = TE.transform(X_val)
        X_test_fold = TE.transform(X_test_fold)

    # Train XGBoost model
    model_xgb = XGBClassifier(**config.xgb_params)
    model_xgb.fit(X_train, y_train, eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)], verbose=False)

    # Predict probability for positive class
    val_preds = model_xgb.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]

    # Store OOF predictions
    xgb_oof_preds[val_idx] = val_preds

    # Store fold predictions for plotting
    fold_preds.append((y_val.values, val_preds))

    # Average predictions across folds
    xgb_test_preds += model_xgb.predict_proba(X_test_fold)[:, 1] / kf.get_n_splits()

    # Evaluate fold performance
    fold_score = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds)

    logger.debug(f"Fold {fold}...")
    logger.debug(f"Fold {fold} - AUC: {fold_score:.5f}")

    # Cleanup to save memory
    if len(TE_COLS) > 0:
        del TE
    gc.collect()

# Final OOF evaluation
logger.info("="*80)
logger.info(f"XGB OOF AUC: {roc_auc_score(y, xgb_oof_preds):.5f}")
logger.info("="*80)

# Plot OOF + Fold Metrics
plot_oof_metrics(y_true=y.values, oof_preds=xgb_oof_preds, fold_preds=fold_preds, threshold=0.5)

w_xgb = xgb_auc / total_auc
w_lgb = lgb_auc / total_auc

Recommendation¶

Recommendation

📌 Hospital Recommendations

  • Hospitals should prioritize early screening for high-risk patients (older males, abnormal ECG, chest pain, exercise angina, abnormal imaging results). ECG, stress testing, and fluoroscopy/thallium scans should be used as primary diagnostic tools.

  • A risk-based triage and AI-supported prediction system should be implemented to enable early intervention, targeted prevention programs, and more efficient use of medical resources.
